title: Couple Seated Outdoors, 1950 B&W Snapshot Photograph
description: A black and white snapshot photograph taken in 1950 featuring a smiling man and woman seated together outside on a chair in a sunlit backyard. The front white margin has handwritten ink reading 'Art & Gerald 1950' at the bottom, and the physical print features scalloped deckled borders typical of mid-20th-century amateur photography.
